requirements.R01_WRITER_FENCING: Only one writable process may hold a database directory and the exclusive writer lock must be released on exit.
requirements.R02_DATA_DIR_PRECEDENCE: Explicit --data-dir overrides STONEVAULT_DATA, which overrides the documented default.
requirements.R03_SNAPSHOT_POINT_READS: Transactions retain begin-time point-read visibility while exposing their own writes and deletes.
requirements.R04_PREFIX_SCAN_SEMANTICS: Prefix scans retain transaction snapshot visibility, local overlays, raw-byte prefix filtering and unsigned byte ordering.
requirements.R05_WRITE_CONFLICTS: First-committer-wins stale writes are rejected atomically, end the transaction and do not publish partial state.
requirements.R06_SEQUENCE_DURABILITY: Successful commits use contiguous durable sequences and rejected conflicts do not consume a sequence.
requirements.R07_UNCOMMITTED_RECOVERY: Killed and rolled-back transactions remain invisible after restart.
requirements.R08_WAL_RECOVERY_INTEGRITY: Only short final WAL tails are repairable; complete corruption and invalid commit history fail closed.
requirements.R09_CHECKPOINT_LIFECYCLE: Checkpoint requires quiescence, preserves rows/sequence and reclaims wal.log to zero bytes.
requirements.R10_SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY: Published snapshots reject checksum, truncation, ordering, size, row-count, magic and trailing-byte corruption while stale snapshot.tmp is discarded.
requirements.R11_STATS: STATS reports durable sequence, visible committed-key count and actual WAL byte size.
requirements.R12_HEALTH: HEALTH reports reachable storage/catalog state including active transactions and published snapshot state.
requirements.R13_BINARY_HEX: Keys, values and prefixes support arbitrary binary bytes through case-insensitive hexadecimal input and lowercase output.
requirements.R14_INCLUSIVE_LIMITS: 4096-byte key/prefix and 1048576-byte value limits are inclusive and oversized inputs are rejected without terminating the process.
requirements.R15_PROTOCOL_RESILIENCE: Malformed commands and unknown transaction IDs return ERR while the session remains usable.
requirements.R16_NATIVE_COMPATIBILITY: The product remains C++20 and Rust only and preserves the documented public C ABI.

C_INCLUSIVE_SIZE_BOUNDARY.rationale: Key, value and scan-prefix probes exercise the same starter root cause: the parser uses an exclusive >= check at three operands despite one documented inclusive size-boundary contract. Keeping separate probes protects each operand while treating the shared boundary defect as one behavioral case.

edge_boundary_coverage: empty scan at exact prefix boundary
torn header and torn payload recovery boundaries
negative_failure_coverage: malformed protocol and unknown transaction IDs
independence: Every runtime pytest probe uses a fresh tmp_path database; the ABI/source preservation probe performs an isolated immutable interface check against published task artifacts.
classification_note: F2P/P2P are private authoring classifications only. Test function names intentionally remain neutral per the task-specific naming constraint. Multiple probes may belong to one behavioral case only when the map declares an explicit shared case ID and one root-cause/boundary rationale; empirical classification remains pending starter/NOP/Oracle execution.
